exposure: Morbid obesity (body mass index [BMI] ≥ 40 kg/m(2)) alone (Group 1)
Non-morbidly obese women (BMI < 35 kg/m(2)) undergoing antenatal testing for similar medical comorbidities (Group 3)
Morbid obesity with an additional medical comorbidity (Group 2)
finding: Morbidly obese women undergoing antenatal testing for obesity alone had a lower induction rate and delivered at a later gestational age compared to those with additional medical comorbidities and non-morbidly obese women.
